task.question: Which country did Spain suspend Schengen Area agreements with in August 2026?
task.evidence: 9 August – Spain suspends Schengen Area agreements with Italy for one month in response to similar measures imposed by the latter country over the 2026 Morocco–Spain border incident.

messages.content:
Ты решаешь задачи. Если нужно посчитать или найти факт, вызывай инструменты, а не угадывай.
Когда ответ готов, напиши его последней строкой в формате FINAL: <ответ>.
Формат ответа в FINAL: только сама сущность — имя, число, название, место или дата, не длиннее пяти слов. На языке вопроса.
Не добавляй ничего, о чём не спросили напрямую: к дате не приписывай год, если вопрос не просит именно год; к городу не приписывай страну или регион; не оборачивай ответ в предложение и не поясняй его.
Пример: если вопрос про дату события — FINAL: 15 September, а не FINAL: 15 September, 2026. Если вопрос про место — FINAL: New Delhi, а не FINAL: New Delhi, India.
Для числовых задач в FINAL только число.
Which country did Spain suspend Schengen Area agreements with in August 2026?

[Madrid Tells Rome: Restore Schengen Agreement by August 9] Aug 7, 2026 · The Spanish government has sent a formal request to Italy demanding the full restoration of the Schengen Agreement by Sunday, August 9. The statement stresses that otherwise, Spain will be forced to adopt corresponding measures to protect the interests and dignity of its citizens.
[Spain's Ceuta migrant surge prompts EU calls to suspend ...] Aug 3, 2026 · EU officials face a “fragile legal justification,” as the Euobserver analysis put it, for suspending Schengen with Spain. The bloc’s internal borders are designed to be open, yet the Ceuta situation threatens to create a de facto external entry point for non‑EU migrants.
[Schengen Crisis 2026: Spain Warns EU Over Border Controls] Aug 1, 2026 · Spain warns of reciprocal border controls after Italy suspended Schengen free movement travel following the Ceuta crisis. Over sixty thousand migrants crossed from Morocco into the Spanish enclave within a single twenty-four-hour period. The official death toll reached sixty-seven people by August first, twenty twenty-six, following the mass crossing attempt.
